决赛案例
题目 Growth strategy for Carbonated Co.
You and your team have presented a compelling story in the workshop and now you are invited to present your proposal with
the company leadership team
Your team would need to provide a more specific proposal for the growth strategy you proposed in the 1st round. Specifically,
your team would need to incorporate the feedback you received in the 1st round and address the following questions:
How would you design a high-level growth strategy for Carbonated beverage Co. for next 5 years?
Would be helpful to incorporate your results from 1st round, considering the key successful factors, and include design of
major product offering, branding, channel coverage etc. (no need to cover all dimensions but focus on 2-3 key things)
and highlight why your strategy has its uniqueness to capitalize on the market trends
Any adjacency markets suitable for Carbonated beverage Co. to expand in future? Why?
evolving consumer behaviors?
What would be the 5-year revenue forecast?
What would be the feasible revenue target and path based on your growth story?
What are the key assumptions and growth drivers?
What are the potential risks and mitigants?
